issue.title: dropstart dropdown caret renders on the wrong side
issue.body:
Two smaller, unrelated mixin/utility bugs:

- `core/scss/ui/_type.scss:12,15` — `a`/`a:hover` use `color-mix(in sRGB, transparent, var(--link-color) var(--link-opacity, 100%))`, treating `--link-opacity` as a CSS percentage. Everywhere else in the codebase (`.link-opacity-*` utilities, `_reboot.scss`, `utils/_colors.scss`) it's a unitless 0–1 fraction. The moment any `.link-opacity-*` class sets e.g. `--link-opacity: 0.5`, the substituted value isn't a valid `<percentage>`, the whole `color-mix()` becomes invalid, and the browser drops the declaration — links render black instead of their intended color. Verified live in a browser.
- `core/scss/mixins/_functions.scss:22` — `media-breakpoint-down-than($name, $breakpoints)` forwards its `$breakpoints` argument to `breakpoint-max()` but not to the preceding `breakpoint-prev()` call, so the "previous breakpoint" lookup always uses the global `$grid-breakpoints` even when a caller passes a custom map. Currently latent (no real caller passes a custom map today), but will silently misbehave the moment one does.

issue.title: [BUG] 1.5: combined layout (vertical sidebar + horizontal navbar) no longer works — intentional or regression?
issue.body:
### Tabler version

1.5.0

### Describe the bug

Up to 1.4, a page could render a vertical sidebar (`aside.navbar-vertical`) and a horizontal top navbar (`header.navbar`) at the same time. TablerBundle (Symfony integration, https://github.com/kevinpapst/TablerBundle) ships this as a supported layout.

After upgrading to 1.5, this combined layout is broken. Reference: https://github.com/kevinpapst/TablerBundle/issues/263

### Questions
1. Was the combined layout removed on purpose in 1.5?
2. If yes, can it be documented in the upgrade guide?
3. If no, is there a supported way (attribute or class) to display both navigations at once?
4. Can you bring back this `combined` demo layout?

### Live example

https://web.archive.org/web/20260228100537/https://preview.tabler.io/layout-combo.html

Remove the leftover squircle code

We are not going to use squircle corners at this stage, but dead code for it is still in the repository. The actual implementation is already commented out, so only leftovers remain.

## What to remove

- `squircle-radius()` function in `core/scss/mixins/bootstrap/_border-radius.scss` (line 25)
- The commented-out `@supports (corner-shape: squircle)` block in the same file (lines 42-44)
- Squircle tests in `core/scss/tests/_border-radius.test.scss`
- The orphaned changeset `.changeset/fix-squircle-multi-value-border-radius.md`

## Notes

- Grep for `squircle` across the repo afterwards - there should be zero hits outside of git history.
- Make sure the remaining `border-radius` mixins and their tests still pass.

issue.title: Tom Select dropdown text grows on phones
issue.body:
On phones the `.form-select` wrapper gets `--tblr-form-control-mobile-font-size: 1rem`, the control itself is pinned to the regular size, and a dropdown rendered inside the wrapper inherits the larger size.

Tabler's own components pass `dropdownParent: 'body'`, so this shows only when Tom Select is initialised without it. Proposed fix, harmless either way:

```css
.ts-wrapper:is(.form-control, .form-select) { --tblr-form-control-mobile-font-size: var(--tblr-control-font-size); }
```

Not reproduced with Tabler's components. Reported in user feedback on 1.7.

issue.title: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` in the JavaScript initialisers
issue.body:
`confetti.ts`, `countup.ts` and `sparkline.ts` already check `prefers-reduced-motion`, but the other initialisers do not:

- ApexCharts: `shared/lib/chart-script.ts:200` enables animations unless the demo says otherwise. Disable them when the media query matches.
- Litepicker (`core/js/src/datepicker.ts`), Dropzone, the toggler and nav overflow use CSS transitions that `core/scss/layout/_accessibility.scss` does not cover.

Add a shared `prefersReducedMotion()` helper in `core/js/src/util/` and use it in the three places above. Extend the `prefers-reduced-motion` block in `_accessibility.scss` with the vendor transition classes that are still animated.

issue.title: Data attributes are written with data-tblr- but data-bs-original-title with data-bs-
issue.body:
## Problem

The port reads both prefixes but writes them inconsistently:

- `Manipulator.setDataAttribute` (`core/js/src/bootstrap/dom/manipulator.ts` ~line 46) writes `data-tblr-*` only. Dropdown therefore sets `data-tblr-popper`, and `util/scrollbar.ts` sets `data-tblr-padding-right`, `data-tblr-overflow`, `data-tblr-margin-right`.
- `Tooltip._fixTitle` (`core/js/src/bootstrap/tooltip.ts` ~line 519) writes `data-bs-original-title` literally, while its readers check both `data-bs-original-title` and `data-tblr-original-title` (which is never produced).

Nothing inside Tabler breaks (SCSS selects both `[data-bs-popper]` and `[data-tblr-popper]`), but third-party code that keys on Bootstrap's attributes, such as scroll-lock libraries reading `data-bs-padding-right` or themes styling `[data-bs-popper]`, no longer sees them.

## Fix

Pick one written prefix. Writing `data-bs-*` (upstream behaviour) keeps third-party compatibility; the `data-tblr-*` reads can stay. Alternatively route `_fixTitle` through `Manipulator.setDataAttribute` for consistency and document the change.

issue.title: Add OTP input component
issue.body:
## Summary

Add an OTP (one-time password) input to Tabler on `dev`, ported from Bootstrap 6 (`v6-dev`: `js/src/otp-input.ts`, `scss/forms/_otp-input.scss`, `site/src/content/docs/forms/otp-input.mdx`, `js/tests/unit/otp-input.spec.js`).

The control is a single real `<input>` inside `.otp`. JavaScript renders one `.otp-slot` per character as a visual layer and turns the input into a transparent overlay, so screen readers, password managers and SMS autofill see one ordinary text field.

Options: `length`, `type` (`numeric` | `alphanumeric` | `alpha`), `mask`, `groups`, `separator`.
Methods: `getValue()`, `setValue()`, `clear()`, `focus()`, `dispose()`.
Events: `input.bs.otpInput`, `complete.bs.otpInput` (both expose `event.value`).

## Follow the pattern of these PRs

- #3045 Autosize
- #3046 countup, switch-icon, input-mask, sortable
- #3051 Sparkline
- #3054 Password strength

## Scope (one PR)

- [ ] `core/js/src/otp-input.ts` – Tabler's own module (not `src/bootstrap/`), class ported from v6 almost 1:1. Data API `data-bs-toggle="otp"` with the `data-tblr-toggle` alias, initialised with `SelectorEngine.find` at import time (not `DOMContentLoaded`), `js-docs-start otp-init` marker, exported from `core/js/tabler.ts`.
- [ ] `core/scss/ui/forms/_form-otp.scss` – `.otp*` class names from v6 unchanged, v6 tokens mapped to `dev` variables (`$input-height-lg`, `$input-font-size`, `$input-border-radius`, `$input-disabled-bg`, the `focus-ring` mixin). Custom properties `--otp-*` without prefix, variables in `_variables.scss`, no `@layer`. Validation `.is-valid` / `.is-invalid` on the wrapper added to `ui/forms/_validation.scss`. Sizes `sm` and `lg` only.
- [ ] `shared/ui/OtpInput.astro` – props: `length`, `type`, `mask`, `groups`, `separator`, `connected`, `size`, `ariaLabel`, `id`, `name`, `value`, `disabled`.
- [ ] Preview: `2-step-verification-code.astro` switches to the component (remove the inline script in `CaptureScript`), a section with variants on `form-elements.astro`. No separate demo page.
- [ ] Docs: `docs/content/ui/forms/otp-input.mdx` based on the v6 page, `classnames` via the `class-reference` skill, entry in `shared/data/docs.json`.
- [ ] Tests: port the v6 spec to `core/js/tests/unit/otp-input.spec.ts` (vitest browser mode).
- [ ] Changeset `minor` for `@tabler/core` via `generate-changeset`, PR description via `mr-description`.

## Decisions

- Event names stay `*.bs.otpInput` as in v6, so user code survives 2.0.
- Keep the v6 file structure and the twbs MIT header (cheaper future sync).
- Pre-JS state: `min-height` on `.otp` and a `form-control`-like base look for `.otp-input`, so there is no layout shift before init.
- RTL: `_slotIndexFromPoint` in v6 assumes LTR; fix it in the port (pick the slot by its rect) and report upstream.
- No `-lite` validation variant.

## Gates before the PR

`pnpm run type-check`, `pnpm run lint:prettier`, `pnpm --filter @tabler/core test`, build + `pnpm run bundlewatch` (`tabler.min.js` limit 48 kB, run with the dev server stopped), check-html.
